note: The copy channel map as DATA. Channels are defined by the reader's state when the words arrive. Each format row names where its full spec lives: 'formats.json' means the copy machine writes it today; 'unspecced' means the format is real, evidence may exist, but its writing spec has not been drawn yet — those are the build slots. The page is generated by channel_map_page.py; corpus counts join at build time.
principle: Copywriting is one brain — research, real language, DR structure. Every format is the same brain wearing a different shape. A channel decides the reading context; a format is a data row inside it; the words always come from the same place. Workflows activate a slice of the brain — never a separate copywriter.

sequence: Aggregate our own sources against this map — done: the corpus holds them, counts below are live.
Bake in external swipes on top — in motion: four brands profiled, sourcing layer carries who each wrote for.
Refine the DR injection process against the aggregate — the upgrade that touches every workflow.
One copywriting component; each workflow activates the slice it needs. Format adjustment is the last step, never the first.
